subject: Initial discovery — aligning availability & stakeholders
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Vasquez <evasquez@quantiflow.ai>, Tom Hargreaves <tom.h@quantiflow.ai>
Cc: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 12 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Initial discovery — aligning availability & stakeholders

Hi Elena / Tom —

Thanks again for the time on the call last week. We'd love to lock in a 45–60 minute discovery so our solutions engineer (Ava) can walk through how Redwood would fit into Quantiflow's inference stack and so we can capture procurement/security asks up-front. Proposed agenda (rough):
- 10m intros & success criteria (Elena/Tom)
- 20–30m SE deep dive (Ava)
- 10–15m procurement/security Qs and next steps

Availability options (PDT):
- Mon 8/17 10:00–10:45am PT
- Tue 8/18 1:00–1:45pm PT
- Wed 8/19 8:30–9:15am PT

If none of these work, please propose 2 slots that do and indicate who from procurement/security should join. I attached a short "Prelim Questions" doc that helps Ava prep — feel free to pass to the eng lead or procurement.

Happy to send a calendar invite once we confirm.

Best,
Marcus Lin
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com
(415) 555-0148

Attachment: Quantiflow-Prelim-Questions.docx (1 page)

From: Elena Vasquez <evasquez@quantiflow.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tom Hargreaves <tom.h@quantiflow.ai>, procurement@quantiflow.ai, security-lead@quantiflow.ai
Date: Wed, 12 Aug 2026 11:45:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Initial discovery — aligning availability & stakeholders

Thanks Marcus — appreciate the clear agenda.

Tom and I are generally available next week in the windows you listed, but procurement needs to coordinate internally. Our security lead (cc'd) would like an earlier slot if possible. Can we do Tue 8/18 at 11:00am CT (that would be 9:00am PT) for a 45-minute call? That timing works best for engineering and security on our side.

I've looped in procurement to confirm their rep; they may ask to keep the call to 45 minutes and follow up with a separate procurement-specific meeting for terms. Also, thanks — I'll upload your "Prelim Questions" to our internal thread so the eng lead can review before the call.

Elena Vasquez
Director, Product & ML
Quantiflow
evasquez@quantiflow.ai

Quick notes for the invite/agenda:
- Please confirm the engineering lead who will join and any specific network/KMS questions up-front so Ava can bring relevant slides.
- Procurement: if you prefer a separate cadence for contract discussion, we'll hold commercial specifics to the follow-up meeting.

I'm attaching a one-page POC scope worksheet that helps us draft success metrics and the rough timeline — feel free to update before the call. I'll include a link to a short Redwood architecture overview in the invite.

Marcus

Thanks team — I'll take the SE deep dive. A couple of prep asks from our side:
- If you can share the eng lead's name and preferred calendar link, I'll add a short pre-read (architecture + current infra bullet points).
- Do you expect to discuss production data handling / retention in the first call, or should we leave that to a follow-up with security?

45 minutes is perfect. I'll plan for a 30-minute technical dive with 15 minutes for procurement/security Qs.

—Ava
